name: Nike Community Discounts
description: 10% off reusable discount for verified community members
fullDescription: Nike offers 10% off for students, military members, first responders, medical professionals, and teachers on Nike.com and in the Nike App.
whatTheyOffer:
- 10% off most items on Nike.com and Nike App (applies to first $500 of a purchase)
- First responders and medical professionals can get a new single-use code every 7 days
- Codes expire two weeks after they're issued
- Excludes Nike By You, gift cards, select Launch/SNKRS products, and Apple products
- Free Nike Membership required
howToGetIt:
1. Sign in or join as a free Nike Member
2. Go to Nike's help page for your group and verify status through SheerID
3. Eligible: students, military, first responders (EMTs, firefighters, law enforcement), medical professionals, teachers
4. Receive a 10% off promo code after verification
5. Use the code on Nike.com or in the Nike App (not valid in Nike stores for first responder/medical codes)
keywords: Nike, military discount, student discount, teacher discount, first responder, nurse, 10% off, shoes, athletic, SheerID
